title: VideoExpress Agent Intake Configuration Schema
description: Structured intake parameters collected when 'Create a VideoExpress Video' or 'Use VideoExpress Agent' is invoked. Aspect Ratio (16:9 vs 9:16) determines whether the video is a Standard Widescreen Video or a Vertical Short/Reel.

video_type.description: Narrative genre and storytelling structure of the video.

visual_style.description: Locked visual style applied across Master Character (Reference Photo 1), Location References (Reference Photo 2), Image Prompts, and VideoExpress select-type dropdown.

aspect_ratio.description: Project-wide aspect ratio invariant. 16:9 produces a Standard Widescreen Video (1920x1080); 9:16 produces a Vertical Short/Reel (1080x1920). Never use 1:1.

target_seconds.description: Explicit target duration in seconds when preset is custom_seconds or user specifies a runtime.

estimated_scenes.description: Planned number of 3-6s connected visual beats.

input_mode.description: Whether the user provided Just Title & Context (Agent writes full script & beats) or a Full Script (Agent segments & calibrates beats).

title_or_topic.description: Working title or central topic of the video.

context_notes.description: Optional context, tone, protagonist traits, setting, or moral/takeaway when input_mode is title_and_context.

full_script_text.description: Complete narration or scene-by-scene script when input_mode is full_script.

route.description: Route A: In-app VideoExpress CloneVoice narration + Auto Align; Route B: Studio Hybrid pipeline with mouth-locked video clips, -14 LUFS voiceover, and -20dB sidechain-ducked BGM.

narrator_voice.description: System voice name (e.g., Beau Whitaker, en-US-ChristopherNeural, Lilly) or authorized cloned voice.

mouth_lock_enabled.description: Enforce sealed closed-lip smile and non-mouth emotional expression when narration is third-person voiceover.
